description.value:
Your eyes conceal a tiny psychic projector that, when focused on a target, allows you to imprint an image of Hell straight into their consciousness.

Activate—Hellsight 2 (concentrate, fear, mental, visual)

Frequency once per day

Effect You focus your eyes on a creature that can see you within 30 feet, forcing them to see nightmarish visions of Hell. The target attempts a @Check[will|dc:27] saving throw.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Frightened]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The target is frightened 1 and becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Fatigued].

Critical Failure As failure, but the target is also @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Drained]{Drained 1} for as long as it's fatigued.
